title: How to extract the last word from a cell
task: Grab the final word — surnames, trailing codes, last path segments.
explanation: The mirror of the nth-word trick: pad every space to 100 spaces so each word occupies its own wide slot, take the RIGHTmost 100 characters — which can only contain the final word plus padding — and TRIM it clean: "gamma". Works in every version of everything. On modern versions TEXTAFTER(A2," ",-1) states the intent directly, and swapping the delimiter handles paths ("/") or filenames (".") — that variant is the text-after-last-delimiter recipe.
